question: What does the existing EMA programme actually require, which gates overlap, and how does it differ from a primary author's intraday EMA teaching?
declared_scope: Post-outcome diagnostic of already exposed original June/September 2025 data, not a new economic backtest or untouched assessment.
scope_rows: Exactly the original full CSVs and 200 real warmup rows; original decision source rows 199 through N-2, execution rows 200 through N-1. No added market data.
allowed_computation: Verify original request/response/witness/process and dataset hashes before analysis
Prepare original features and source signals once per month using the unchanged registered runtime
Count closed-price core touch/reclaim and pretrend conditions before ADX/RSI; reconcile actual raw signals against original traces
Measure session and original ADX-derived confidence gate intersections on all raw signals and on observed flat original candidates separately
Describe original first-veto censoring, occupied positions and outcome-dependent state without fabricating replacement state
Record past-only last-20-bar EMA overlap and slope-direction-change descriptors; these are not learned trend labels or filters
Select illustrative original candidates by fixed chronological category, never profit or favorable future outcome
forbidden: changing any parameter, clock, cost or gate
agent-owned learning or automatic policy attachment

examples.selection: First chronological case per month/category: original fill, outside-session/confidence-pass, outside-session/confidence-fail, in-session-confidence-fail, occupied-or-state-different, exact session boundary if observed. Missing category is absent, not synthesized.
examples.reading: Original execution index minus one is the closed signal candle. No future return determines example selection. Author charts are educational illustrations, not audited trading results.

next_decision: Retain the old programme unchanged. Choose one prospective source-faithful discovery question only after source, trigger, management and observable-data differences are explicit. A static gate pass alone never authorizes a replay or claims profitability.
data_policy: All 2026 and later market observations remain paper-only. No broker demo account is available; this diagnostic is neither broker demo nor prospective paper execution.
